# Cabinet Dentaire Dr. Abdessadok

Cabinet Dentaire Dr. Abdessadok is a dental practice in Sète, France. The site provides patient information about dental implants, invisible orthodontics, general dental care, access, opening hours and contact options.

Clinical information is general and does not replace an examination. Translated pages do not promise that consultations are available in the translated language.

## Practice and access

- Practitioner: Dr Abdessamed Abdessadok, chirurgien-dentiste.
- Address: RDC, 10 Bd Danièle Casanova, 34200 Sète, France.
- Telephone: 04 22 91 05 94.
- Contact and current opening hours: https://cabinetdentairesete.fr/contact/
- Appointments and follow-up take place in Sète. Nearby-town pages do not describe additional practice locations.
